profile: shore-reference-v2 candidate: DOS-inspired stony banks and blue-teal water; no original outlines measured. Explicit corner land profiles, lakeside23 effective land-side mask234. Guard through8worldpx and exterior/filtermargin: nearest edge LL+32, WW-32, mixed signed midpoint projection toward land. Two mixed edges per shore, one contiguous land arc. Inward unit edge normals for8worldpx; quintic Bezier anchors A,B, h=.24*|B-A|, controls A,A+h*nA,A+2h*nA,B+2h*nB,B+h*nB,B. Chord-normal displacement .7*64*t^3*(1-t)^3*sin(2*pi*t+.4) vanishes with first two derivatives at anchors. Flatten256 steps, signed nearest segment distance,160worldpx exterior extensions. Shared mirror-periodic sampleConnectionMaterial grass/water/bank. Pure grass field>=8 and water<=-7. Otherwise u=2*pi*x/71,v=2*pi*y/40; d=field+.65*sin(3*u+2*v)+.35*sin(7*u-5*v)+.65*((bank.R+bank.G+bank.B)/765-.5). With S=clamped smoothstep: shallow=blend(water,RGB(97,159,152),.28), wet=blend(bank,RGB(38,65,58),.62); blend water->shallow S((d+5.5)/2.5), ->wet S((d+2.2)/.9), ->bank S((d+.9)/1.4), ->grass S((d-3.8)/2.4). Lattice-periodic broken bank outline preserves reciprocal joins; pale gravel band has dark wet lip and blue-green submerged shelf. Byte-rounded RGB blends. Opaque unmasked4x margin4worldpx; whole416x352 Lanczos3 to208x176, crop then complementary hard polygon ownership at2x/4x. Bases byte-exact existing material adapter. Source-over decoded actualPNG scenes, deterministic vertex-constraint CSP for center/ring contacts at both lineparities. Pixel-aligned2x/4x only.
